summary: PLE tables can live in caller-provided mapped host memory, so several processes can share one copy
compatibility: No user action required. Without a caller-provided allocator PLE storage is allocated as before.
details: allocate_storage and TableLayout.allocate_storage take an optional host_allocator that supplies each mapped-host table plane. The storage checks the region's shape, dtype, device and mapped device alias, and owns it afterwards.
vLLM uses it to keep one tmpfs copy of the 26.8 GiB Qwen3.8-Flash-Next PLE table for several TP1 servers on one host (VLLM_PLE_TABLE_MEMORY=shared).
Planes allocated before a failed allocation are released at once instead of at garbage collection.
